segments.name: ODR
segments.description: Performs owner direct projects, maintenance and specialty contracting on mechanical, electrical, plumbing and controls systems for building owners and operators.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in two segments; (i) Owner Direct Relationships ("ODR"), in which the Company performs owner direct projects and/or provides maintenance or service primarily on MEPC systems, and specialty contracting projects to existing buildings direct to, or assigned by, building owners or operators

segments.name: GCR
segments.description: Manages new construction and renovation projects involving primarily MEPC systems for general contractors and construction managers.
segments.evidence: The Company provides its GCR services through the following project delivery methodologies

revenueModel.text: Building owners and operators, and general contractors or construction managers, pay for MEPC projects, maintenance, service and specialty contracting work.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company partners with building owners and operators of mission-critical facilities across healthcare, industrial and manufacturing, data centers, life sciences, higher education, and cultural and entertainment markets.
